meta.title: InnerOutliner - Outline. Focus. Done.
meta.description: InnerOutliner is a local-first task outliner that turns scattered ideas into executable plans. Private by design - no cloud, no account required.
meta.keywords: InnerOutliner, task outliner, local-first, todo app, task manager, productivity, offline
meta.ogDesc: A local-first task outliner. Your data stays on your device. Always.

hero.lead: Turn scattered thoughts into a clean, executable task structure. Nested outlines, subtasks, reminders - everything stays on your device.

stats.label: No sync delay, no login required

features.heading: Everything you need.
features.subheading: Designed for focused work. No subscriptions to worry about, no data leaving your machine.

items.title: Nested outlines
items.desc: Break any goal into parent tasks and subtasks. Crystal-clear structure.

items.title: Board view
items.desc: See every list as a column side by side. Drag tasks across lists and reorder columns in seconds.

items.title: Priority pinning
items.desc: Hoist today's most critical items to a dedicated pinned area. Stay laser-focused.

items.title: Reminders
items.desc: Native desktop notifications at the date and time you pick. Never miss a follow-up again.

items.title: Due dates
items.desc: Per-task deadlines with clear Due Today and Overdue labels, so nothing slips through.

items.title: Progress reports
items.desc: Weekly, monthly and yearly charts reveal your completion rhythm over time.

items.title: Drag & reorder
items.desc: Restructure your lists and sublists instantly with fluid drag-and-drop.

items.title: Filter
items.desc: Find any task by text and narrow the view to incomplete or completed tasks only.

items.title: Themes & dark mode
items.desc: Light, dark or Auto to follow your OS, nine color themes and adjustable window opacity.

items.title: Always on top & edge snap
items.desc: Keep your list above other windows, or snap it to the screen edge to collapse it until you hover.

items.title: Backup, restore & CSV
items.desc: Save everything to a backup file, merge or replace on restore, and export tasks to CSV.

items.title: Multi-language UI
items.desc: Switch the entire interface language in one tap - 10 locales and growing.

spotlight.heading: Plan, schedule and review -
spotlight.subheading: A closer look at the tools that keep your work moving. Everything runs locally on your device.

board.title: See every list side by side
board.desc: Switch to Board and each of your lists becomes its own column. Get the big picture at a glance, then move work exactly where it belongs.
points: Drag a task to another column to move it to that list - its subtasks come along
Drag columns to reorder your lists
Add, edit and complete tasks right inside each column
Drop tasks into subtasks and track progress like 2/3 at a glance
board.svgLabel: Board view with three list columns and a task being dragged from one column to another

reminder.title: A nudge at exactly the right moment
reminder.desc: Attach a reminder to any task or subtask. When the time comes, InnerOutliner shows a native desktop notification - no account, no server, no cloud involved.
points: Pick a day on the calendar and a time in 5-minute steps
Native OS notification shows the task text
Click the notification to jump straight back into the app
Change or remove a reminder at any time
reminder.svgLabel: A task with a reminder set for 09:30 and the desktop notification it triggers

dueDate.title: Know what's due before it's late
dueDate.desc: Give any task or subtask a deadline. InnerOutliner tells you how much time is left and makes overdue work impossible to miss.
points: Set or remove a due date from a simple calendar
Clear status labels: Due in, Due Today and Overdue
Due-today and overdue tasks stand out with distinct colors
Completed tasks show whether they were done on time
dueDate.svgLabel: Task list showing due date labels: due in 3 days, due today, overdue, and done on time

report.title: See your progress take shape
report.desc: Reports turn your task history into a clear trend line, so you can see how much you finish and what's still open.
points: Switch between Week, Month and Year, and step back through past periods
Filled line chart of completed vs. incomplete tasks
Summary table with incomplete, completed and total per period
Covers tasks and subtasks across all your lists
report.svgLabel: Weekly report line chart comparing completed and incomplete tasks from Monday to Sunday

privacy.summary: How InnerOutliner handles information and protects your privacy.

sections.heading: Local data by default
paragraphs: Your tasks, outlines, reminders, and settings are stored locally on your device.
InnerOutliner does not require an account or upload your task data to our servers during normal use.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: InnerOutliner does not collect personal information from within the application.
If you contact us for support, we use the information you provide only to respond to your request.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
paragraphs: Because your data remains on your device, you are responsible for keeping backups and securing access to your device.

terms.summary: The terms that apply when you use InnerOutliner.

sections.heading: Using the app
paragraphs: You agree to use InnerOutliner in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
You may use the app for personal or business task planning, provided that use does not violate these terms.

sections.heading: Availability
paragraphs: InnerOutliner is provided as-is, without guarantees of uninterrupted availability or compatibility with every environment.
We may update, change, or discontinue features as the app evolves.

sections.heading: Your data
paragraphs: You are responsible for your content and for maintaining backups, since your data is stored locally on your device.

security.summary: How InnerOutliner reduces risk with a local-first design.

sections.heading: Local-first architecture
paragraphs: InnerOutliner is designed to keep your task data on your device, minimizing remote attack surface.
No always-on cloud synchronization is required for normal operation.

sections.heading: Device protection
paragraphs: Protect your device with a strong sign-in method and keep its operating system up to date.
Install app updates when available to receive the latest improvements and security fixes.

sections.heading: Reporting concerns
paragraphs: If you believe you have found a security issue, contact us through the support channel listed on the main site.
